// Generated from Source/Editor/Full. Do not edit this template directly.
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace RVFX.DestructionSystem
{
    internal sealed partial class RVFXPortablePlaybackEditor
    {
        private bool _showEffects = true;

        private bool DrawPlaybackEffects(RVFXPieceTransformPlayback playback)
        {
            var data = serializedObject.FindProperty("playbackEffects");
            var filters = data.FindPropertyRelative("filters");
            bool filtered = data.FindPropertyRelative("filterVersion").intValue > 0;
            var bindings = data.FindPropertyRelative("bindings");
            int count = filtered ? filters.arraySize : bindings.arraySize;
            bool changed = false;
            using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(RVFXPortablePlaybackInspectorGUI.Card))
            {
                _showEffects = EditorGUILayout.Foldout(_showEffects, "EFFECTS", true, EditorStyles.foldoutHeader);
                if (!_showEffects) return false;
                if (count == 0)
                {
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("No effect filters were baked. Add filters in Rig > GPU Playback > Effects, then build the playback prefab.", MessageType.Info);
                    return false;
                }
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Replace effect prefabs without rebaking motion.", EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Recorded triggers stay unchanged. Edit a prefab asset to change its particle materials.", EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();
                if (filtered)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < filters.arraySize; i++)
                    {
                        var filter = filters.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i);
                        var name = filter.FindPropertyRelative("name").stringValue;
                        using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(EditorStyles.helpBox))
                        {
                            EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(filter.FindPropertyRelative("enabled"),
                                new GUIContent(string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) ? "Filter " + (i + 1) : name, "Enable this baked effect filter."));
                            bool manual = filter.FindPropertyRelative("trigger").intValue == (int)RVFXPlaybackEffectTrigger.Manual;
                            var type = filter.FindPropertyRelative("eventType");
                            EditorGUILayout.LabelField(manual ? "Recorded manual points" : "Recorded " + ObjectNames.NicifyVariableName(type.enumNames[type.enumValueIndex]), EditorStyles.miniLabel);
                            using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(!filter.FindPropertyRelative("enabled").boolValue))
                                DrawPlaybackEffectSlots(filter.FindPropertyRelative("effects"), manual, true);
                        }
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Legacy bake: existing effect slots can be replaced. Rebuild from the Rig to use modern filters and natural particle tails.", MessageType.Info);
                    DrawPlaybackEffectSlots(bindings, false, false);
                }
                changed = EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck();
                if (GUILayout.Button(new GUIContent("Refresh Effects", "Recreate particles at the current playback time after editing a prefab or material. Does not rebake motion.")))
                {
                    serializedObject.ApplyModifiedProperties();
                    playback.RefreshPlaybackEffects();
                    SceneView.RepaintAll();
                }
                if (EditorApplication.isPlaying)
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Play Mode edits are temporary. Edit outside Play Mode to save them.", MessageType.Info);
            }
            return changed;
        }

        private static void DrawPlaybackEffectSlots(SerializedProperty slots, bool manual, bool allowAdd)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < slots.arraySize; i++)
            {
                var slot = slots.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i);
                var prefabProperty = slot.FindPropertyRelative("prefab");
                using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(EditorStyles.helpBox))
                {
                    using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
                    {
                        EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(slot.FindPropertyRelative("enabled"), new GUIContent("Effect " + (i + 1)));
                        if (allowAdd && GUILayout.Button(new GUIContent("Remove", "Disconnect this slot; keep the prefab asset and recorded events."), EditorStyles.miniButton, GUILayout.Width(58)))
                        {
                            slots.DeleteArrayElementAtIndex(i);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    EditorGUI.BeginProperty(EditorGUILayout.GetControlRect(), new GUIContent("Prefab"), prefabProperty);
                    prefabProperty.objectReferenceValue = EditorGUI.ObjectField(GUILayoutUtility.GetLastRect(), new GUIContent("Prefab"), prefabProperty.objectReferenceValue, typeof(GameObject), false);
                    EditorGUI.EndProperty();
                    var prefab = prefabProperty.objectReferenceValue as GameObject;
                    if (prefab == null)
                        EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Assign a prefab to enable this effect slot.", EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                    else if (prefab.GetComponentsInChildren<ParticleSystem>(true).Length == 0)
                        EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("No ParticleSystem found in this prefab or its children. Animator, VFX Graph and custom scripts do not follow the playback clock automatically.", MessageType.Warning);
                    EffectField(slot, "scaleMultiplier", "Scale", "Multiply the prefab's original scale.");
                    // Reserve space for the foldout arrow inside the slot's border.
                    using (new EditorGUI.IndentLevelScope())
                        slot.isExpanded = EditorGUILayout.Foldout(slot.isExpanded, "Lifetime & Placement", true);
                    if (slot.isExpanded)
                    {
                        if (allowAdd)
                        {
                            EffectField(slot, "lifetimeMode", "Lifetime", "Auto lets non-looping particles finish naturally. Timed stops emission at the time limit.");
                            EffectField(slot, "maxEmissionTime", "Emission Limit (s)", "Limits loops in Auto mode, or all emission in Timed mode. Remaining particles can finish.");
                        }
                        else
                            EffectField(slot, "destroyAfterSeconds", "Lifetime (s)", "Legacy total lifetime. Rebuild from the Rig for Auto/Timed emission and natural particle tails.");
                        EffectField(slot, "positionOffset", "World Offset", "Offset the recorded spawn location in world space.");
                        if (!manual) EffectField(slot, "alignToSurface", "Align Impact", "Align local +Y with the recorded surface normal.");
                        EffectField(slot, "parentToActor", "Follow Playback", "Parent to the playback root, not an individual fragment.");
                    }
                }
            }
            if (allowAdd && GUILayout.Button("Add Effect", EditorStyles.miniButton))
            {
                int index = slots.arraySize++;
                slots.GetArrayElementAtIndex(index).boxedValue = new RVFXDestructionEffectBinding();
            }
        }

        private static void EffectField(SerializedProperty slot, string path, string label, string tooltip)
        {
            EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(slot.FindPropertyRelative(path), new GUIContent(label, tooltip));
        }
    }
}
#endif
